workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. Here are the 30-minute slots they both have free for the partners' meeting next week:

Mon, Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
Tue, Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed, Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
Thu, Nov 19: 10:00, 14:30
Fri, Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Please check the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor for a matching slot. Let me know what you find and I'll book it.

Thanks,
Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked the calendars and Thursday, November 19 at 14:30 is the only time that works for everyone. Please book it. I'll send the confirmation email once you confirm it's done.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, I've booked the meeting for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. It's over to you to send the confirmation email.

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

Date: Thursday, November 19, 2026
Time: 14:30-15:00 Eastern Time

A calendar invitation with a video conferencing link has been sent to your inboxes.

Best regards,
Brad
